claims.indicator: The beacon light is flashing red.
claims.failure: A fault has occurred.
claims.conditions: Flashing red beacon light.

claims.indicator: The beacon light is flashing red.
claims.failure: The machine is in Emergency Stop.
claims.conditions: Flashing red beacon light.

claims.indicator: The umbrella tool changer is jammed.
claims.conditions: Do not put hands near the tool changer unless an alarm is displayed first.
claims.action: Remove the cause of the jam.

claims.indicator: The umbrella tool changer is jammed.
claims.conditions: Do not put hands near the tool changer unless an alarm is displayed first.
claims.action: Press RESET to clear the alarms.

claims.indicator: The umbrella tool changer is jammed.
claims.conditions: Do not put hands near the tool changer unless an alarm is displayed first.
claims.action: Press RECOVER and follow the directions to reset the tool changer.

claims.indicator: Check that the tool probe operates correctly.
claims.conditions: The probe LED flashes green after activation; touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED; RESET turns the probe LED off.
claims.action: In MDI mode, run M59 P2; G04 P1.0; M59 P3.

claims.indicator: Check that the tool probe operates correctly.
claims.conditions: The probe LED flashes green after activation; touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED; RESET turns the probe LED off.
claims.action: Touch the tool-probe stylus.

claims.indicator: Check that the tool probe operates correctly.
claims.conditions: The probe LED flashes green after activation; touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED; RESET turns the probe LED off.
claims.action: Press RESET to deactivate the probe.

claims.indicator: Check that the work probe operates correctly.
claims.conditions: The probe LED flashes green after activation; touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED; RESET turns the work-probe LED off.
claims.action: Select the work probe with a tool change, or manually insert it into the spindle.

claims.indicator: Check that the work probe operates correctly.
claims.conditions: The probe LED flashes green after activation; touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED; RESET turns the work-probe LED off.
claims.action: In MDI mode, run M69 P2 to start communication with the work probe.

claims.indicator: Check that the work probe operates correctly.
claims.conditions: The probe LED flashes green after activation; touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED; RESET turns the work-probe LED off.
claims.action: In MDI mode, run M59 P3.

claims.indicator: Check that the work probe operates correctly.
claims.conditions: The probe LED flashes green after activation; touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED; RESET turns the work-probe LED off.
claims.action: Touch the work-probe stylus.

claims.indicator: Check that the work probe operates correctly.
claims.conditions: The probe LED flashes green after activation; touching the stylus produces a beep and red LED; RESET turns the work-probe LED off.
claims.action: Press RESET to deactivate the probe.

claims.indicator: The door has not yet been cycled after power-up, so the door sensor has not been confirmed to work.
claims.conditions: The Cycle Door icon appears after [POWER UP] if the user has not yet cycled the door.
claims.action: Cycle the door at least once.

claims.indicator: The door is open.
claims.conditions: Door Open warning icon.

claims.indicator: The pallet load station is open.
The light curtain is triggered.
claims.conditions: The icon appears when the machine is idle or a program is running and the light curtain is triggered.
claims.action: Remove the obstacle from the light-curtain line of sight.

claims.indicator: The Light Curtain Hold icon appears while the light curtain is triggered during a running program.
claims.conditions: Program is running.
claims.action: Press [CYCLE START] to clear the icon.

claims.indicator: Low gearbox oil flow has persisted for one minute.
claims.conditions: Low gearbox oil flow persists for 1 minute.

claims.indicator: The control detected a low gearbox oil level.
claims.failure: The control detected a low gearbox oil level.
claims.conditions: In software version 100.19.000.1100 and higher, monitoring occurs when the spindle fan is off, after a delay.
claims.action: Press [RESET] to clear the low gearbox oil icon.

claims.indicator: The rotary table lubrication reservoir requires checking and filling.
claims.action: Check the rotary-table lubrication oil reservoir.

claims.indicator: The rotary table lubrication reservoir requires checking and filling.
claims.action: Fill the reservoir.

claims.indicator: The Through-Spindle Coolant or High-Pressure Flood Coolant filter is dirty.
claims.failure: The TSC/HPFC filter is dirty.
claims.action: Clean the filter.

claims.indicator: The coolant concentrate level is low.
claims.action: Fill the concentrate reservoir for the coolant refill system.

claims.indicator: The system detects a low-oil condition in the PulseJet reservoir.
claims.failure: The PulseJet oil reservoir has a low-oil condition.

claims.indicator: The Low Lube icon appears.
claims.failure: The spindle lubrication oil system detected a low-oil condition.

claims.indicator: The Low Lube icon appears.
claims.failure: The axis ball-screw lubrication system detected low grease or low pressure.

claims.indicator: The rotary brake oil level is low.
claims.failure: The rotary brake oil level is low.

claims.indicator: Residual pressure is detected before a lubrication cycle.
claims.failure: An obstruction in the axes grease lubrication system can cause the residual pressure.
claims.conditions: Detected by the grease pressure sensor before a lubrication cycle.

claims.indicator: The mist extractor filter needs cleaning.
claims.action: Clean the mist extractor filter.

claims.indicator: The coolant level is low.
claims.failure: Coolant level is low.

claims.indicator: The PulseJet oil level is low.
claims.failure: PulseJet oil level is low.

claims.indicator: Air flow is not sufficient for correct machine operation.
claims.failure: Air flow is not sufficient for correct machine operation.
claims.conditions: The icon applies in Inch Mode and Metric Mode.

claims.indicator: The HPU oil level is low.
claims.failure: The HPU oil level is low.
claims.action: Check the oil level.

claims.indicator: The HPU oil level is low.
claims.failure: The HPU oil level is low.
claims.action: Add the recommended oil for the machine.

claims.indicator: The HPU oil temperature is too high for reliable operation.
claims.failure: The oil temperature is too high to reliably operate the HPU.

claims.indicator: The spindle fan has failed.
claims.failure: The spindle fan has stopped operating.

claims.indicator: Cabinet temperatures are approaching levels that may be dangerous to the electronics (Electronics Overheat warning).
claims.conditions: If temperature reaches or exceeds the recommended level, alarm 253 ELECTRONICS OVERHEAT is generated.
claims.action: Inspect the cabinet for clogged air filters and correctly operating fans.

claims.indicator: The electronics remain in the overheat state too long; the machine will not operate until corrected.
claims.failure: The electronics remain in the overheat state too long.
claims.action: Inspect the cabinet for clogged air filters and correctly operating fans.

claims.indicator: The transformer is overheated for more than one second (Transformer Overheat warning).
claims.failure: The transformer is detected to be overheated for more than 1 second.

claims.indicator: The transformer remains overheated too long; the machine will not operate until corrected.
claims.failure: The transformer remains in the overheat state for too long.

claims.indicator: Incoming voltage is low (Low Voltage warning).
claims.failure: The PFDM detects low incoming voltage.
claims.conditions: If the condition continues, the machine cannot continue to operate.

claims.indicator: Incoming voltage is too low to operate (Low Voltage alarm).
claims.failure: The PFDM detects incoming voltage that is too low to operate.
claims.conditions: The machine will not operate until the condition is corrected.

claims.indicator: Incoming voltage is above the set limit but remains within operating parameters (High Voltage warning).
claims.failure: The PFDM detects incoming voltage above a set limit but within operating parameters.
claims.action: Correct the condition to prevent damage to machine components.

claims.indicator: Incoming voltage is too high to operate and could damage the machine (High Voltage alarm).
claims.failure: The PFDM detects incoming voltage that is too high to operate.
claims.conditions: The machine will not operate until the condition is corrected.

claims.indicator: A Surge Protector fault has been detected.
claims.conditions: The icon remains active until the fault is cleared. Continuing to use the machine in this state could allow an electrical surge to damage the electronics.

claims.indicator: The robot battery is low.
claims.failure: The pulse-coder batteries are low.
claims.conditions: If the robot is turned off, it may require remastering.
claims.action: Replace the pulse-coder batteries as soon as possible.

claims.indicator: The robot battery is low.
claims.failure: The pulse-coder batteries are low.
claims.conditions: If the robot is turned off, it may require remastering.
claims.action: Do not turn off the robot.

claims.indicator: Air pressure to the machine is too low to reliably operate pneumatic systems (Low Air warning).
claims.failure: Air pressure to the machine is too low to reliably operate pneumatic systems.
claims.action: Correct the condition to prevent damage to or incorrect operation of pneumatic systems.

claims.indicator: Air pressure is too low to operate pneumatic systems (Low Air alarm).
claims.failure: Air pressure to the machine is too low to operate pneumatic systems.
claims.conditions: The machine will not operate until corrected.
claims.action: A higher-capacity air compressor may be needed.

claims.indicator: Air pressure to the machine is too high to reliably operate pneumatic systems (High Air warning).
claims.failure: Air pressure to the machine is too high to reliably operate pneumatic systems.
claims.action: Correct the condition to prevent damage to or incorrect operation of pneumatic systems.

claims.indicator: Air pressure to the machine is too high to reliably operate pneumatic systems (High Air warning).
claims.failure: Air pressure to the machine is too high to reliably operate pneumatic systems.
claims.action: Install a regulator at the machine air input if needed.

claims.indicator: Air pressure is too high to operate pneumatic systems (High Air alarm).
claims.failure: Air pressure to the machine is too high to operate pneumatic systems.
claims.conditions: The machine will not operate until corrected.
claims.action: Install a regulator at the machine air input if needed.

claims.failure: The Emergency Stop on the pendant has been pressed.

claims.indicator: The Emergency Stop on the auxiliary device has been pressed.
claims.failure: The Emergency Stop on the auxiliary device has been pressed.

claims.failure: The Emergency Stop on the RJH-XL has been pressed.
claims.action: Release the Emergency Stop on the RJH-XL to clear the icon.

claims.failure: The tool or tool group has expired, and no replacement tools are available.

The tool in the spindle is unclamped.
claims.failure: The tool in the spindle is unclamped.
